Q6097.reason: Under modern law, 'heirs of his body' is often interpreted as creating a fee simple absolute rather than a limited estate.

Q5137.reason: An expert witness cannot testify to an opinion based on facts (x-rays) that have not been introduced into evidence first.

Q5526.reason: Burglary requires unlawful entry with the intent to commit a felony inside; entering an open window and stealing drugs satisfies this definition.
